name: GOSSAMER DIVORCE
source:
« 15 days remain until the next pulse. »

At the foot of the Leucothoe resonator, a diseased corpse is grotesquely splayed in a pile of mannequins.

On the bustling marina of Fuveu's Promenade Portuaire, a bizarre altercation culminates in a stabbing in the midst of the tourist crowds.

From these points of origin, a single catastrophic week unfolds on the microplanet of Archalh - a small, recently settled territory held by one of the long-established interplanetary nations of the “macrocosme”, joined across the span of a naturally-occurring interstellar circulatory system. 

In the interval between the pulses that connect it to the wider macrocosme, every planet becomes a “closed circle”, unable to interact with the universe beyond it.

And when the next pulse at last arrives, whatever has been born on Archalh will finally be able to slip outside its borders…

[From [url=https://molluscdeflation.itch.io/gossamerdivorce]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“距离下一次脉动还剩15天。”

在留科托厄共鸣塔脚下，一具染病的尸体以怪诞扭曲的姿态横陈在人体模型堆中。

在菲沃港滨海步道熙熙攘攘的游艇码头上，一场离奇的争执在密集的游客人群中以持刀行凶惨烈收场。

以此为起点，灾难性的一周在微型行星阿尔卡赫上骤然展开——这颗面积狭小、新近开拓的领地隶属于“大宇宙”中某个历史悠久的星际国家，借由天然形成的星际循环系统与外界相连。

在连接广阔大宇宙的两次“脉动”间隔期内，每一颗行星都会化作一座与世隔绝的“密室孤岛”，无法与外界宇宙发生任何交互。

而当下一次脉动终于降临之时，在阿尔卡赫上孕育诞生的那件东西，也将终于得以溜出它的边境……
